query: On L1 only, configure an eBGP neighbour for S1 at 10.1.1.1 with remote AS 65100.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - BGP-E-01
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prerequisite: L1<->S1 have no IP reachability on the 10.1.1.x
    # link yet - Ethernet4 (L1) only has its original fabric address
    # (10.0.0.2/31), unrelated to the 192.168.10.0/24 management
    # network used for SSH. Without an address in 10.1.1.0/31 here,
    # BGP can never get past Idle, no matter how correct the neighbor
    # config is. This is additive - the existing fabric IP on
    # Ethernet4 is left in place, SONiC interfaces support multiple IPs.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Add IP 10.1.1.0/31 to Ethernet4 on SONiC-VS-1 (link to S1)
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Ethernet4 10.1.1.0/31
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify Ethernet4 has IP 10.1.1.0/31 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: eth4_ip_output
      failed_when: >-
        eth4_ip_output.rc != 0
        or 'Ethernet4' not in eth4_ip_output.stdout
        or '10.1.1.0/31' not in eth4_ip_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # L1's local AS must be 65001 (confirmed: S1's real local AS is
    # 65100, matching what L1's neighbor already expects via
    # remote-as 65100; for the pairing to work as genuine eBGP, L1
    # itself must be AS 65001, matching what S1's neighbor expects via
    # remote-as 65001). Detect whatever AS is currently running; if
    # it's something other than 65001 (e.g. the pre-existing 65100
    # fabric config), remove that instance first - this also removes
    # any peers under it (confirmed: none of the existing 32 fabric
    # peers were ever Established, so nothing live is disrupted), since
    # only one router bgp instance can exist. If nothing is configured
    # yet, this step is skipped and 65001 is created fresh below.
    # Interface IP addressing is untouched either way - router bgp
    # config and interface config are independent in FRR/SONiC.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Capture current BGP state on SONiC-VS-1 (informational, may not be running)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: bgp_summary_precheck
      ignore_errors: true
      changed_when: false

    - name: Determine current local AS on SONiC-VS-1 (empty if none configured)
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        current_local_as: >-
          {{ (bgp_summary_precheck.stdout | regex_search('local AS number (\d+)', '\1'))[0]
             if (bgp_summary_precheck.stdout is defined and 'local AS number' in bgp_summary_precheck.stdout)
             else '' }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Remove existing router bgp instance on SONiC-VS-1 if it is not already 65001
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "no router bgp {{ current_local_as }}" -c "exit"
      when: >-
        inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
        and current_local_as != ''
        and current_local_as != '65001'
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify old router bgp instance was removed on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: >-
        inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
        and current_local_as != ''
        and current_local_as != '65001'
      register: bgp_removed_check
      failed_when: >-
        bgp_removed_check.rc != 0
        or ('local AS number ' + current_local_as) in bgp_removed_check.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ensure router bgp 65001 exists (creates it fresh if it didn't
    # already, or if it was just removed above) and add the eBGP
    # neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65100 under it
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure router bgp 65001 with neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65100 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65100" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.1.1 configured with local AS 65001 and remote-as 65100 on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: bgp_neighbor_output
      failed_when: >-
        bgp_neighbor_output.rc != 0
        or '10.1.1.1' not in bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'remote AS 65100' not in bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'local AS 65001' not in bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'external link' not in bgp_neighbor_output.stdout

    - name: Verify session with 10.1.1.1 is NOT Established on SONiC-VS-1 (S1 has no matching config)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: bgp_state_output
      failed_when: bgp_state_output.rc != 0 or 'established' in bgp_state_output.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Persist configuration
    # NOTE: this neighbor lives in FRR's own config, not Redis CONFIG_DB,
    # so it must be saved and verified via vtysh, not `config save`.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Save SONiC-VS-1 FRR configuration
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.1.1 present in SONiC-VS-1 running-config
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config" | grep "neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65100"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: save_output
      failed_when: save_output.rc != 0 or 'neighbor 10.1.1.1 remote-as 65100' not in save_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # S1 (SONiC-VS-5) must remain completely untouched
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify S1 (SONiC-VS-5) has no matching neighbor for L1 (10.1.1.1)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_output
      failed_when: s1_bgp_output.rc != 0 or '10.1.1.1' in s1_bgp_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Both hosts must still reach their own default gateway
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify AlpineLinux-1 (H1) still reaches its own default gateway
      raw: ping -c 3 -W 2 $(ip route show default | awk '{print $3}')
      when: inventory_hostname == "AlpineLinux-1"
      register: h1_ping_output
      failed_when: h1_ping_output.rc != 0 or '0% packet loss' not in h1_ping_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify AlpineLinux-2 (H2) still reaches its own default gateway
      raw: ping -c 3 -W 2 $(ip route show default | awk '{print $3}')
      when: inventory_hostname == "AlpineLinux-2"
      register: h2_ping_output
      failed_when: h2_ping_output.rc != 0 or '0% packet loss' not in h2_ping_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Final BGP Neighbor Configuration on SONiC-VS-1
      debug:
        msg:
          - "Previous local AS (before this run): {{ current_local_as if current_local_as != '' else 'none' }}"
          - "Current local AS: 65001"
          - "{{ bgp_neighbor_output.stdout_lines }}"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
